_readme: Words of the SF6 Slots Loader plugin: the source of truth, compiled into the DLL by tools/localisation/gen_plugin_words.py. Same shape as the other modules' locale.json. The language follows the game's text language; a missing word or language: English. %s / %d are format slots, in order. The words the game already has are not here: plugin/locale/game_words.json. _context: where each word shows; max: the room, in units (one unit: about half the font size; a CJK, kana or Hangul character is 2, any other 1), checked by tools/localisation/check_locale.py.

replay.tab.where: Replays menu: the name of the 6th tab, after Search. Tab bar (items 288 apart), narrow.

replay.row_outfits.where: Replays > Settings: first option row, on the left (as Battle Settings > Other's rows), and a heading of the summary panel. Mirrors the game's 'Opponent Outfit Settings'.

replay.row_music.where: Replays > Settings: third option row's name, with its value and arrows on its right (room for the name: 265 px at font 25), and a heading of the summary panel. Wael's wording in French.

replay.custom.where: Replays > Settings: last value of the Replay Music row, between its arrows; also in the summary, followed by the number of tracks. Wael's wording in French.

replay.custom_list.where: Replays > Settings: guide bar entry on the Custom value, and the title of the game's playlist dialog. Wael's wording in French.

replay.sum_grid.where: Replays > Settings: the title pill of the summary panel on the right (pill 270 px wide, font 19).

replay.sum_page.where: Replays > Settings, a character's page: the title pill of the summary panel. Mirrors the game's 'Outfit Settings (Opponent)'.

replay.desc_grid.where: Replays > Settings: the bottom description line (it scrolls) on the outfit row and the character grid.

replay.desc_page.where: Replays > Settings: the bottom description line on a character's page.

replay.desc_stage.where: Replays > Settings: the bottom description line on the stage row and grid.

replay.desc_music.where: Replays > Settings: the bottom description line on the Replay Music row.

replay.stage_default.where: Replays > Settings: caption of the first stage cell, in capitals (cell 252 px wide, font 24). The replay keeps its own stage.

replay.stage_n.where: Fallback name of a stage whose name is unknown. %d: the stage's number.

replay.fighter_n.where: Fallback name of a fighter unknown to this version (a newer DLC). %d: the fighter's number.

replay.more.where: Replays > Settings, summary panel: last line when too many fighters are set. %d: how many more.

fmt.name_value.where: Pattern of a summary line: 'Name: value'. Two %s. Keep the language's own punctuation.

fmt.fighter_outfit.where: Pattern of a summary line: fighter, outfit, colour ('Luke: Outfit 4, 01'). Three %s. Keep the language's own punctuation.

options.title.where: Costume options: the entry in the guide bar (Fighter Settings, Replays > Settings, select screen), the menu's section name, a heading of the summary panel.

options.player_side.where: Costume options menu: the first row's name, its values are the game's P1 / P2.

options.player_side_desc.where: Costume options menu: description of the Player side row (it scrolls). %s: the game's word for P1.

options.desc_toggle.where: Costume options menu: description of an on / off row. A sentence follows (options.live_*).

options.desc_pick_none.where: Costume options menu: description of a row of choices with a None value. %s: the game's word for None. A sentence follows (options.live_*).

options.desc_pick_required.where: Costume options menu: description of a row of choices without None. A sentence follows (options.live_*).

options.live_replay.where: Costume options menu opened from Replays > Settings: second sentence of a row's description.

options.live_player.where: Costume options menu: second sentence of a row's description. %s: the game's word for P1 or P2.

options.partial.where: Costume options menu: third sentence of a row whose option cannot fully change at once. The row's name carries the same *.

options.restore_desc_replay.where: Costume options menu opened from Replays > Settings: description of the row that restores the defaults (the game's 'Restore Default Settings'). Fluffy is a tool's name.

options.restore_desc_player.where: Costume options menu: description of the row that restores the defaults. %s: the game's word for P1 or P2. Fluffy is a tool's name.

options.other_row.where: Costume options menu: first value of a row of a group split over several rows: the choice is on another row (narrow value).

stage.variation.where: Stage grids (Battle Settings, Training, Replays > Settings): guide bar entry after the key icon, on a stage that has variations.

nsfw.display.where: Options > Interface > Other Settings: row name.

nsfw.display_desc.where: Options: description of that row (it scrolls). costume_mods_nsfw is a folder name. %s, %s: the game's words for Off and Outfit 1.

nsfw.online_outfit.where: Options > Interface > Other Settings: row name. What other players see when you wear a modded outfit.

nsfw.online_outfit_desc.where: Options: description of that row (it scrolls). %s, %s, %s: the game's words for Battle Settings, DriveTech and Outfit 1.
